lines.en: I follow you with light steps.
My joints creak, but I keep going.
I walk half a step to your left.
My short legs carry me quickly.
My name is Fredbear; remember it.

lines.zh: 我踩到什么都会吱一声
lines.en: Anything I step on squeaks.
My ears wobble as I walk.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边扫描周围
lines.en: I scan around us as I walk.
Not too fast; I can keep up.
My soles are hard.
I skirt the edge of the rug.
I am idling; my eyes stay lit.
Do your work; I will watch.
My gears turn softly.
I raise a hand, then lower it.
My head dips as if dozing.
The lamp makes me shine.
I am waiting for you to call me.

lines.zh: 这里很安全，我检查过了
lines.en: It is safe here; I checked.
I do not move when I stand guard.
Listen; my spring is ticking.
I am a little worn.
I count the gaps between your breaths.
Do not turn off the light; I dislike the dark.
I am ready whenever you need me.
I will stand by the door.
I know your face.
My eyes stay fixed on you.
You are the one I claimed.
I am reading your expression.
You frowned; what is wrong?
My jaw is a little loose.

lines.zh: 你笑起来，我也亮了一点
lines.en: When you smile, I glow a little.
Two steps away; close enough?
You may pat my head.
I promise not to bite.

lines.zh: 我记住了你走路的节奏
lines.en: I know the rhythm of your walk.
You came back later than yesterday.
I have been waiting for you to turn.
You smell of someone else.
Do not be afraid; I am a toy.
I bow my head; that is courtesy.

lines.zh: 你看我时，我就不那么旧了
lines.en: When you look at me, I feel less worn.
I saved you a place.
Where are you going? I will check the way.
A crack opened in my shell.
No pain; I only make noise.
My stuffing is showing.
The hit knocked me askew.
Master, I am fine.
I can still keep standing.
I will need repairs after this.
My spring loosened half a turn.
Do not worry; I am sturdy.
I still have to guard you.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，但我可以拿着
lines.en: I do not eat, but I can hold it.
I take it with both hands.

lines.zh: 我把它放进你的背包里
lines.en: I will put it in your pack.
My mouth is decoration.
Feed me and I will only stare.
This smells like sugar.
Thank you; I will remember.

lines.zh: 我更想要你摸摸我的头
lines.en: I would rather have a pat on the head.
Not too close; I might drool.

lines.zh: 我的外壳磕到你，声音很闷。
lines.en: My shell knocks against you with a dull thud.
My shell is hard.
You are not hurt anywhere, are you?
I step back to let you pass.
We made quite a clatter.
I caught you in time.
My arms are not very flexible.
A bump will not break me.
You are standing on my foot.
Next time I will walk ahead.
I am a toy; I do not understand this.
I can only stand with you.
I have no program for that.
You need someone living.

lines.zh: 我会一直在这儿，这样就够
lines.en: I will stay here; that is enough.
There is only a spring in my chest.
Do not ask me that.
Let me walk you back to bed.
I prefer standing watch.
Let us keep things as they are.
I picked it up; here.
This was dropped at the door.
My hands are clumsy.
I put it away for you.
It has dust on it.

lines.zh: 我举高一点，你看得见吗
lines.en: I hold it higher; can you see?
Do not drop it twice.
I counted; nothing is missing.
Can this thing still be fixed?
It is safer in your pocket.
If someone hurts you, I step in.
I have that one locked.
Do not stand behind my back.
I go first; you stay back.

lines.zh: 我的动作不快，但会咬住
lines.en: I am not fast, but I hold on.
That one is hostile; I can tell.
My eyes turned red.
You are hurt; that will not do.
Clear the doorway first.
I am shielding you; keep still.
I have its position.
Master, stand behind me.
I am on my way right now.
Do not let it touch you.
I am tracking along behind it.
It turned; we follow.
My legs are short, but I do not stop.
Stay behind me; do not get lost.
Its footsteps are heavy.
We go around its side.
It has seen us.
My gears are spinning fast.
Hold on to my shoulder.
Two paths ahead.
It backed off; we press on.
I still have power.
I hear it breathing.
Do not split up; stay close.
It is trying to get behind us.
I am blocking the door.
You are panting; slow down.
It will not get far.
I bit down hard.
This blow is by the book.
My claws are not that sharp.
You hit it; I go for its leg.
I ram its side.
I shoved it aside.
My arm sticks a little.
One more; I can still move.
I bit down and held.
It kicked me; I am fine.

lines.zh: 我挡在你前面挨了一下
lines.en: I took a hit in front of you.
That blow was meant for you.
I am not strong, but I am stubborn.
It retreated; do not chase far.
My shell has a dent.
I can do that again.
I am here, master.
I climbed out of a box.
Someone was within two blocks; it was you.
I have claimed you; do not send me away.
My eyes just lit up.
This place is roomier than the cupboard.
I stand up, a little shorter than you.
There is still sawdust on me.

lines.zh: 我听见你的脚步声就出来了
lines.en: I came out when I heard your steps.
Do not step on me; I am not steady.
I am here, and I will follow you.
No one called me; it was you.
My stage is no longer here.
This hand can grip things now.
I checked; you are alone.
From today, I keep watch over you.
My head tilts; that is normal.
Turn around and look at me.
My fabric is burning.
I landed and my leg bent.
Water soaks into my stuffing.
The arrow went through my shoulder.

lines.zh: 法术让我的关节不听使唤
lines.en: The spell froze my joints.
I do not eat; my power is draining.
Lightning made me jerk.
It is too dark here; I cannot see you.
